# epicurves

Likelihood inference for epidemic curves. The package accompanies two
manuscripts in preparation derived from Jaciele Oliveira’s doctoral
thesis (Programa de Pós-Graduação em Estatística, UFPE) and reproduces
their analyses.

- **Stochastic compartmental models under the Gaussian approximation.**
  Any mass-action model is declared by its events
  ([`ga_model()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/ga_model.md),
  [`ga_event()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/ga_event.md)),
  observed through the incidence of events or the prevalence of
  compartments, with under-reporting and time-varying rates, and fitted
  by maximum likelihood with a Kalman filter
  ([`ga_fit()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/ga_fit.md),
  [`ga_profile()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/ga_profile.md),
  [`ga_bootstrap()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/ga_bootstrap.md)).
  The SIRD model fitted to daily cases and deaths has a dedicated
  interface
  ([`sird_ga_fit_inc()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_ga_fit_inc.md),
  [`sird_ga_fit_tv()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_ga_fit_tv.md)).
- **Growth-curve ensembles on daily counts.** Logistic, Gompertz and
  Richards curves are fitted by Poisson or negative binomial likelihood
  and combined with Akaike weights
  ([`fit_ensemble_incidence()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/fit_ensemble_incidence.md));
  a series is divided into phases by penalised likelihood
  ([`bic_segment()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/bic_segment.md))
  or by anytime-valid sequential e-detectors
  ([`edetect_segment()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/edetect_segment.md)).

The `paraiba_covid19` dataset holds the COVID-19 surveillance series for
Paraíba, Brazil, used in both applications.

## Installation

``` r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("Raydonal/epicurves")

# optional, needed by edetect_segment():
remotes::install_github("castlaboratory/edetect")
```

## Example

Declare a SIRD model, simulate reported cases and deaths, and fit it:

``` r
library(epicurves)

sird <- ga_model(c("S", "I", "R", "D"), list(
  infection = ga_event("S", "I", rate = "lambda", by = "I"),
  recovery  = ga_event("I", "R", rate = "gamma"),
  death     = ga_event("I", "D", rate = "alpha")))
obs <- list(cases  = ga_incidence("infection", prob = "p", noise = "tau2"),
            deaths = ga_incidence("death", prob = 1, noise = "tau2_d"))

truth <- list(lambda = 0.6, gamma = 0.3, alpha = 0.1, p = 0.5, tau2 = 0.2, tau2_d = 0.1)
set.seed(1)
sim <- ga_simulate(sird, truth, c(S = 19990, I = 10, R = 0, D = 0), obs, n = 80)

init <- function(p) c(S = 1 - p$i0, I = p$i0, R = 0, D = 0)
fit <- ga_fit(sird, sim$data, obs, N = 20000, init = init,
              start = list(lambda = 0.5, gamma = 0.25, alpha = 0.15, i0 = 1e-3,
                           p = 0.6, tau2 = 0.3, tau2_d = 0.3))
confint(fit)
```

Divide the daily deaths in Paraíba into phases:

``` r
data(paraiba_covid19)
seg <- bic_segment(paraiba_covid19$new_deaths, d_min = 12, family = "negbin", step = 5)
paraiba_covid19$date[seg$cuts]
```

The articles on the package website work through both methods in detail.
`NEWS.md` records the findings made while validating the package against
the thesis.

# Package index

## Compartmental models under the Gaussian approximation

Any mass-action compartmental model, incidence or prevalence
observations, time-varying rates.

- [`ga_model()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/ga_model.md)
  : Define a mass-action compartmental model

- [`ga_event()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/ga_event.md)
  : Define an event of a mass-action compartmental model

- [`ga_incidence()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/ga_incidence.md)
  [`ga_prevalence()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/ga_incidence.md)
  : Observation streams for the Gaussian-approximation likelihood

- [`ga_loglik()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/ga_loglik.md)
  : Gaussian-approximation log-likelihood of a compartmental model

- [`ga_simulate()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/ga_simulate.md)
  : Exact simulation of a compartmental model and its surveillance
  counts

- [`ga_fit()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/ga_fit.md)
  : Maximum likelihood for a compartmental model under the Gaussian
  approximation

- [`ga_profile()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/ga_profile.md)
  :

  Profile log-likelihood for one parameter of a `ga_fit`

- [`ga_bootstrap()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/ga_bootstrap.md)
  :

  Parametric bootstrap for a `ga_fit`

- [`confint(`*`<ga_fit>`*`)`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/confint.ga_fit.md)
  :

  Wald confidence intervals for a `ga_fit`

- [`confint(`*`<ga_boot>`*`)`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/confint.ga_boot.md)
  :

  Bootstrap confidence intervals for a `ga_boot`

- [`predict(`*`<ga_fit>`*`)`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/predict.ga_fit.md)
  :

  One-step-ahead predictions from a `ga_fit`

- [`plot(`*`<ga_fit>`*`)`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/plot.ga_fit.md)
  :

  Plot the one-step-ahead predictions of a `ga_fit`

## SIRD-GA from daily cases and deaths

- [`sird_ga_simulate_inc()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_ga_simulate_inc.md)
  : Simulate daily reported cases and deaths from the SIRD jump process
- [`sird_ga_loglik_inc()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_ga_loglik_inc.md)
  : SIRD-GA log-likelihood for daily reported cases and/or deaths
- [`sird_ga_fit_inc()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_ga_fit_inc.md)
  : Maximum likelihood for SIRD-GA from daily cases and/or deaths
- [`sird_ga_fit_tv()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_ga_fit_tv.md)
  : SIRD-GA with piecewise-constant transmission, fitted to cases and
  deaths
- [`sird_ga_profile()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_ga_profile.md)
  : Profile log-likelihood of one SIRD-GA parameter
- [`sird_ga_loglik_prev()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_ga_loglik_prev.md)
  : Fast Kalman log-likelihood for prevalence observations

## SIRD-GA: dynamics, simulation and the prevalence model

- [`sird_drift()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_drift.md)
  : Deterministic SIRD drift vector

- [`sird_jacobian()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_jacobian.md)
  : Jacobian of the SIRD drift vector

- [`sird_diffusion()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_diffusion.md)
  : Diffusion covariance matrix of the SIRD jump process

- [`sird_sigma()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_sigma.md)
  : Diffusion "square-root" factor of the SIRD jump process

- [`sird_R0()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_R0.md)
  : Basic reproduction number of the SIRD model

- [`sird_ode_solve()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_ode_solve.md)
  : Solve the deterministic normalised SIRD ODE system

- [`sird_gillespie()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_gillespie.md)
  : Exact stochastic simulation of the SIRD jump process (Gillespie
  algorithm)

- [`sird_ga_simulate_obs()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_ga_simulate_obs.md)
  : Simulate partially-observed SIRD-GA surveillance data

- [`sird_ga_transition()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_ga_transition.md)
  : Solve the SIRD-GA state-space transition quantities

- [`sird_ga_Ak()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_ga_Ak.md)
  :

  Resolvent matrix \\A\_{k-1} = \Phi(t_k, t\_{k-1})\\ of interval `k`

- [`sird_ga_Fk()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_ga_Fk.md)
  :

  Drift increment \\F_k\\ of interval `k`

- [`sird_ga_Qk()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_ga_Qk.md)
  :

  State-noise covariance \\Q_k\\ of interval `k`

- [`sird_ga_loglik()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_ga_loglik.md)
  : Kalman-filter log-likelihood of the SIRD-GA state-space model

- [`sird_ga_fit()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_ga_fit.md)
  : Maximum (approximate) likelihood estimation for the SIRD-GA model

- [`sird_ga_fit_multistart()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_ga_fit_multistart.md)
  : Multi-start SIRD-GA fitting, with a practical-identifiability
  summary

- [`sird_ga_bootstrap()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/sird_ga_bootstrap.md)
  : Parametric bootstrap confidence intervals for the SIRD-GA MLE

## Growth curves on daily counts

- [`logistic_curve()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/logistic_curve.md)
  : Logistic growth curve
- [`gompertz_curve()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/gompertz_curve.md)
  : Gompertz growth curve
- [`richards_curve()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/richards_curve.md)
  : Richards growth curve
- [`growth_incidence()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/growth_incidence.md)
  : Daily incidence implied by a growth curve
- [`fit_growth_incidence()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/fit_growth_incidence.md)
  : Fit one growth curve to daily counts by maximum likelihood
- [`fit_ensemble_incidence()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/fit_ensemble_incidence.md)
  : Ensemble of growth curves fitted to daily counts
- [`predict_band()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/predict_band.md)
  : Forecast band of a growth-incidence fit

## Segmentation of epidemic curves

- [`bic_segment()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/bic_segment.md)
  : Offline segmentation of daily counts by penalised likelihood
- [`edetect_segment()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/edetect_segment.md)
  : Online segmentation of an epidemic curve with e-detectors

## Ensembles on cumulative counts (earlier approach)

- [`fit_growth_model()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/fit_growth_model.md)
  : Fit a single growth-curve model by nonlinear least squares
- [`ensemble_weights()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/ensemble_weights.md)
  : Inverse-criterion ensemble weights
- [`fit_ensemble()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/fit_ensemble.md)
  : Fit the full ensemble of growth-curve models to one data window
- [`predict(`*`<ensemble_fit>`*`)`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/predict.ensemble_fit.md)
  : Predict the ensemble curve at arbitrary times
- [`ensemble_bootstrap_ci()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/ensemble_bootstrap_ci.md)
  : Bootstrap confidence band for an ensemble fit
- [`ensemble_bootstrap_params()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/ensemble_bootstrap_params.md)
  : Bootstrap confidence intervals for each growth model's parameters
- [`split_mse()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/split_mse.md)
  : Mean squared error of a split at a single candidate partition point
- [`split_mse_single()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/split_mse_single.md)
  : Best single-model split MSE at a candidate partition point (fast
  proxy)
- [`find_partition_point()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/find_partition_point.md)
  : Grid search for a single structural change (partition) point
- [`permutation_test_partition()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/permutation_test_partition.md)
  : Permutation test for a single candidate structural change point
- [`fit_piecewise_ensemble()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/fit_piecewise_ensemble.md)
  : Sequential piecewise ensemble model
- [`predict(`*`<piecewise_fit>`*`)`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/predict.piecewise_fit.md)
  : Predict from a piecewise ensemble fit
- [`smooth_series()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/smooth_series.md)
  : Centered moving-average smoother

## Plotting

- [`plot_ensemble_fit()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/plot_ensemble_fit.md)
  : Plot an ensemble fit against the observed data
- [`plot_partition_profile()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/plot_partition_profile.md)
  : Plot an MSE (or AIC) profile from a partition-point grid search
- [`plot_piecewise_fit()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/plot_piecewise_fit.md)
  : Plot a fitted piecewise ensemble curve, with confirmed partition
  points
- [`plot_sird_ga_fit()`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/plot_sird_ga_fit.md)
  : Plot observed vs. fitted SIRD-GA incidence, with an optional
  bootstrap band

## Data

- [`paraiba_covid19`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/paraiba_covid19.md)
  : COVID-19 surveillance data, Paraíba, Brazil (2020)
- [`paraiba_population`](https://raydonal.github.io/epicurves/reference/paraiba_population.md)
  : Population of Paraíba, Brazil
